entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker dragon who plots with Azor to trap Nicol Bolas and is defeated by him on Tarkir.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A 10,000-year-old sphinx hieromancer who severs his spark to create the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who defeats Ugin, hunts for Azor's agenda and plans to conquer Ravnica.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker working for Bolas who sets up a sabotage by having Jace hide her memories.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and Living Guildpact who hides Vraska's memories of him to sabotage Bolas.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: One of Bolas's associates who uses the Planar Bridge and whom Vraska is to call.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon on Ravnica whom Jace suggests to plan the sabotage.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: The sphinx who taught Jace the technique Oubevir's Maneuver.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A crew member of the Belligerent to whom Jace sends a message.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A crew member of the Belligerent to whom Jace sends a message.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: The crew member Vraska leaves in charge of the Belligerent.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact Azor made by severing his spark, a lock to trap planeswalkers, taken off Ixalan through the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A portal that can transport objects across planes, used by Bolas's agents.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: The compass Vraska uses to find the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's ship.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The city in which Azor sealed himself with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Azor built the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The continent where Azor built the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Ugin lured Bolas.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Bolas's goal and the home of Jace and Vraska.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas built an army of Eternals.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane to which Bolas sent Tezzeret for a portal.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Jace's friends are.

entities.name: Palace of Justice
entities.description: The building in Azor's city where he and Ugin plotted.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: A Ravnican market Vraska wants to show Jace.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Jace's group of planeswalkers.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Zombie soldiers treated with lazotep to survive interplanar travel.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Vraska's guild, whom she fears will suffer.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The conquerors who arose from the monastery that first had the Sun.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A kingdom to which Azor gifted the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The people Azor charged with guarding Orazca.

events.summary: Ugin arrives on Azor's newest plane, welcomed by crowds, to meet his associate.
events.quote: His name was Ugin, and his purpose was, and always had been, singular.

events.summary: Ugin tells Azor he has a plan to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Azor outlines creating the Immortal Sun on Ixalan to summon Bolas, at the cost of his spark.
events.quote: I will build the Immortal Sun there, on the continent of Torrezon.

events.summary: Ugin says he will lure Bolas to Tarkir.
events.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas interrogates an elf bureaucrat about the lawbringer and learns of Azor.
events.quote: The sphinx was called Azor.

events.summary: On another plane Bolas absorbs a lawmage's mind, learning of the plot and killing her.
events.quote: listening to him and the Spirit Dragon plot the end of the True Evil

events.summary: Azor severs his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Bolas appears before Ugin on Tarkir, having followed Azor's clues.
events.quote: when his nemesis appeared before him

events.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
events.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

events.summary: Bolas overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and attackers.
events.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws.

events.summary: A man out of time preserves Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone.
events.quote: That man preserved Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone and vanished.

events.summary: Bolas planeswalks away, believing he has won.
events.quote: And Nicol Bolas planeswalked away, never to return, for he had won.

events.summary: Azor waits in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.
events.quote: Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

events.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
events.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

events.summary: Azor seals himself in Orazca and charges the River Heralds to guard it.
events.quote: this time sealing himself within the walls of Orazca and charging the River Heralds

events.summary: Jace and Vraska share everything they know about Bolas.
events.quote: Jace told Vraska everything he knew about Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

events.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
events.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

events.summary: Jace shows Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.
events.quote: He was trying to break into Nicol Bolas's mind.

events.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
events.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

events.summary: Bolas scrambles Jace's memories, but a trap Jace's mind carried sends him to Ixalan.
events.quote: a part of Jace's mind propelled him from Amonkhet to Ixalan.

events.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
events.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

events.summary: Vraska asks Jace to take and hide her memories of him so Bolas will not see them.
events.quote: I need you to temporarily take my memories of you.

events.summary: Jace recognizes the plan is to betray Bolas.
events.quote: You want to betray Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Vraska lays out the plan to accept Bolas's offer of guild leader and wait until Jace restores her memories.
events.quote: He promised me the title of guild leader.

events.summary: Jace explains Oubevir's Maneuver can hide the gap in Vraska's memories.
events.quote: It's a way to smooth over evidence of mental tampering.

events.summary: They choose Niv-Mizzet as the one to help devise the plan.
events.quote: He could challenge Nicol Bolas both physically and mentally

events.summary: Jace and Vraska swear oaths to keep her memories safe and to sabotage Bolas when they are returned.
events.quote: I swear to commit my conscious self to his destruction.

events.summary: Jace says he must meet his friends on Dominaria.
events.quote: I need to meet my friends on Dominaria.

events.summary: Jace sends Vraska's message to her crew, leaving Amelia in charge.
events.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

events.summary: Jace promises to call Vraska Captain before restoring her memories.
events.quote: I'll call you Captain.

events.summary: Vraska invites Jace to a date at Tin Street Market and he accepts.
events.quote: It's a date.

events.summary: Jace seals Vraska's memories of him in a warded box hidden in her mind.
events.quote: She saw her memories of Jace tied up in a bundle, placed within a box, sealed with an unbreakable ward.

events.summary: Vraska wakes without her memories of Jace in the empty throne room.
events.quote: How did I get here?

events.summary: Vraska casts the spell that opens a violet portal beneath the Immortal Sun, which is pulled to another plane.
events.quote: when a violet circle opened up directly beneath the Immortal Sun

events.summary: The Immortal Sun is pulled away and Vraska planeswalks off Ixalan.
events.quote: As the portal closed, Vraska planeswalked away.

relations.note: Ugin calls Azor his friend and plots with him.

relations.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

relations.note: She works for Bolas for the power promised for her service.
relations.quote: allowed her the power he had promised her in return for her service
Bolas sent Tezzeret to Kaladesh to retrieve a portal that can transport objects.
There's a technique Alhammarret taught me,

relations.note: They agree to a date after the plan.
She is captain of the Belligerent.
relations.quote: You have my word as captain of the Belligerent

relations.note: They pledge to sabotage Bolas together.
